style.prompt: A charming cartoon of a little orange robot doing an ordinary household task: gently watering a single leafy green potted plant with a small watering can. Cozy simple setting, soft colors, rounded shapes, warm gentle mood. Widescreen composition with robot and plant fully visible below a clear title area. One continuous steady shot for all 8 seconds: the robot carefully tilts the watering can, a gentle stream waters the soil, and the robot straightens the can. Throughout the entire video, from first frame to last, display the exact words 'Small steps' at the top center in clear, stable, easily legible lettering. Keep the title stationary and unchanged for the full duration. No other text. Silent, no sound.
